name: Museum Art
description: Public-domain works from a museum's open collection (the Art Institute of Chicago, The Met or the Cleveland Museum of Art), one picture per page on a blurred margin, with its title, artist, date and museum. A search narrows the works; only works the museum marks public domain are shown. No key needed.

credit.text: Artworks and their data from the Art Institute of Chicago, The Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Cleveland Museum of Art

properties.name: searchCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Searches (hours)
properties.description: How long a museum's answer to a search (a page of works) is kept and shared by every task. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: recordCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Works (hours)
properties.description: How long what The Met says about one work (its title, artist and picture) is kept. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: contentCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Downloads (hours)
properties.description: The longest a downloaded picture is kept and shared by every task before it is asked for again. The museum's own headers can shorten this, never lengthen it. 0: download every time.

properties.name: contentCacheMB
properties.title: Downloads Pool Size (MB)
properties.description: The most disk the kept downloads and answers of this data source may use. When it is full, the one used longest ago goes first.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Downloads After (days)
properties.description: A kept download or answer nobody has used for this many days is removed. 0: never.

items.name: Arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas

properties.name: museum
properties.title: Museum
properties.description: aic: the Art Institute of Chicago. met: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. cleveland: the Cleveland Museum of Art.

properties.name: search
properties.title: Search
properties.description: Words the works must match (an artist, a title, a subject: monet, water lilies, ships). Empty: any public-domain work with a picture.

properties.name: department
properties.title: Department
properties.description: The Met only: works of one department. Empty: every department.

properties.name: showCaption
properties.title: Show Caption
properties.description: The work's title, artist, date and museum in small text at the bottom of the page.
